7CCO.terminal_chemistry: Conditional free NH3+/COO- termini and five deprotonated acidic side chains; experimental terminal specification unresolved.
7CCO.vacuum_dianion: Post-added fixed-FF ALPB does not polarize or stabilize the vacuum SCF density self-consistently; finite-basis convergence does not prove electron binding or a stable ground state.
7CCO.frozen_f: Physical La multiplicity1/Dy6; effective singlets with La ECP46/Dy ECP55, spin-free frozen-f representation without SOC.
7CCO.geometry: One fixed 7CCO La-proposed before/after deformation; both endpoints nonstationary, no geometry repair or optimization.
7CCO.reference_scope: Whole vacuum PBE0 replaces all internal electronic/MM terms; only unchanged fixed-FF ALPB is added. No CPCM or external point charges.
7CCO.force_qualification: Native analytic-gradient admission only; no numerical derivative test or statistical force-accuracy threshold in this four-cell proposal.
7CCO.interpretation: Independent conditional force/work diagnostic, not an affinity prediction, an exact MACE training-functional replay, or a unique MM-parameter attribution.

7CCN.source: Lu-conditioned 7CCN; same peptide as consumed7CCO, a distinct prospective deformation, not a blind protein benchmark.
7CCN.geometry: Exact prior whole-MACE La start and 80-step terminal; terminal bound/admitted but nonconverged. No new geometry or optimization.
7CCN.terminal_chemistry: Conditional free NH3+/COO- and five deprotonated acidic side chains; experimental terminal specification unresolved.
7CCN.vacuum_dianion: Post-added fixed-FF ALPB does not polarize the vacuum density; finite-basis SCF convergence does not prove electron binding or ground-state stability.
7CCN.frozen_f: Physical La1/Dy6; effective singlets, La ECP46/Dy ECP55, no SOC or physical-state qualification.
7CCN.force: Native analytic admission only, no finite-difference or force-accuracy qualification. Both Dy MACE force comparisons unavailable; no new MACE requests.
7CCN.interpretation: Per-metal deformation works and Dy-minus-La work difference; no absolute cross-method energies, affinity, classifier or preference claims.
